source: The BaristaPro 9 espresso machine targets enthusiasts who have grown beyond entry-level equipment. I
text_excerpt: The BaristaPro 9 espresso machine targets enthusiasts who have grown beyond entry-level equipment. Its key feature is temperature stability, which maintains brewing temperatures within a narrow range throughout consecutive shots. A silent rotary pump and efficient steam wand support both espresso extraction and milk frothing. New owners should expect a learning curve, as professional-style filter baskets require careful technique. The water management design has some drawbacks; the drip tray needs to be emptied frequently. The total investment extends beyond the machine itself, as a quality grinder must be purchased separately to achieve optimal results.
